title: Shared CARGO_TARGET_DIR on worker hosts gives phantom test failures under concurrent agents
description: worker5 2026-09-09: with CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/home/mark/Cache/cargo-target (the shared dir rust/AGENTS.md tells Linux workers to use), lichen-node --lib intermittently failed 18 tests (dao clock/expiry, version authorization, multicast DIO receive) that are formatting-identical to a tree that scored 358 passed/1 failed minutes earlier. With an isolated target dir (/home/mark/Cache/cargo-target-w5-831k) the same commit passes 358/1 deterministically. Cause: multiple concurrent worker agents (this host runs several opencode workers plus spec-sweep agents at load ~12) build different branch content into the one shared target dir; serialized builds from different checkouts interleave stale artifacts into test binaries. Hazard: workers burn rounds chasing phantom failures or, worse, trust a falsely-green suite. Fix options: (a) per-worker target dir by default (CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/home/mark/Cache/cargo-target-$WORKER_N in each worker's env script), (b) a run-wrapper that locks/fences the shared dir, or (c) document + enforce sccache-like per-checkout caches. Infra fix belongs to the driver/host setup, not worker code.
